jamie (eng-platform): Quick sync — planning to stage-enable feature flag model_v3_toggle tomorrow 09:00 UTC. Ramp plan: 0% -> 1% -> 5% -> 20% over ~3h per region. Asking for any objections or missing guardrails.

lee (eng-runtime): 👍 sounds fine. Confirming we have the fallback mapping to model_v2_cached for any ERROR responses.

maria (eng-ml): Does eval-suite v3.1 run as a post-rollout job? Need to ensure generation quality at 5% before 20%.

jamie (eng-platform): Yes, post-rollout eval will run automatically. Also we'll have an automatic rollback trigger if latency P90 > 600ms or error rate > 0.8% for 10m.

sara (oncall): @jamie please add the oncall playbook link and the contact list. Also can we add a preflight check to ensure KV cache priming completes? Last time cold-started badly.

jamie (eng-platform): Good call. Preflight checklist (will run 30m before):
- run cache-priming job for top 100 prompts
- verify autoscale target healthy
- confirm canary metrics in dashboard

Deploy command (for ops/runbook):
```
ffctl set model_v3_toggle --enable --percent 1 --region all --staged
sleep 30m
ffctl set model_v3_toggle --percent 5
sleep 120m
ffctl set model_v3_toggle --percent 20
```

lee (eng-runtime): Small note: for region-specific ramp we should run per-region commands to avoid cross-region blast radius. Example:
```
ffctl set model_v3_toggle --region europe-west1 --percent 1
```

maria (eng-ml): I'll queue the eval job and attach the prompt set. Will post results to #ml-evals and ping here.

deploy-bot: scheduled rollout 'model_v3_toggle' created by jamie at 2026-03-18T09:00:00Z — preflight scheduled 2026-03-18T08:30:00Z :rocket:

sara (oncall): sounds good. I'm on standby for the 09:00 window. If the rollback triggers hit, who's the lead to approve immediate rollback? @lee?

lee (eng-runtime): I'm the rollback lead. I'll take it and coordinate with infra. If anything, hit me on slack + pager.

jamie (eng-platform): Thanks everyone. I'll update the runbook with the per-region commands and threshold numbers, then create the scheduled rollout in the console. Final call: no blockers, proceed with staged enable tomorrow. :white_check_mark:
